methodology.provenance: Runtime modules/public config separated from unreachable/operator source, tests, documentation and comments; static declaration is not deployed-use proof
methodology.locations: Stable source/context anchors instead of line numbers so unrelated line shifts do not stale evidence
methodology.build: Ignored build/dependency outputs excluded; no build run or remote resource retrieval
methodology.dynamic: Generic surfaces are possibilities shared by a set, never claims that a specific record references a particular asset

representations.rules: Exact case-sensitive path below client/public; relative paths resolved by source context. Query/fragment removed for local comparison only; percent decoding once; traversal, encoded separators and ambiguous case are unresolved.
websiteImageRegistry defaultUrl/key -> SiteSettings.websiteImages.images[].key/defaultUrl/url/imageUrl/mediaId; a fallback path in code does not prove which image CMS currently serves.

Media has original/thumbnail/medium URL and s3Key variants. s3.js can emit S3 URLs or development /uploads paths. Client helpers remap /uploads to API origin. Do not map an arbitrary URL pathname or basename to a repository file.

File.filename stores a private key when isPrivate=true; ServiceTemplate.files.uploads[].key and JobApplication.cvKey are private keys. privateStorage creates private/ keys; local private uploads are not statically served. Issued URLs are temporary and must never be retained as identity.
Join locally to the complete allowlisted Media/File reference projection using capture-local HMAC identifiers; no customer/user profiles. Media.filename alone cannot identify a repository asset.

Discard credentials/query/fragment before any identity handling; unknown/private locators exported as HMAC only. Origin/CDN/prefix aliases require explicit owner evidence; never guess from suffix or same basename.
Typed nested fields, arrays, Mixed/Object/Map blobs and text/HTML/Markdown require bounded local extraction. Unknown shapes and historical collections remain unresolved, not empty.
